news.headline: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs above $81,000 as majors rally ahead of Fed decision
Zcash extends gains as geopolitical fears ease ahead of the FOMC decision. What's next?
news.summary:
Zcash extended the gains yesterday as renewed hopes for a US–Iran deal helped improve risk sentiment across crypto markets. Reports that Iran's security chief met with Supreme Leader Khamenei raised hopes of a potential agreement. However, a sustained recovery in ZEC will likely require more concrete progress, as setbacks or renewed tensions could quickly reverse recent gains.

There might also be some pre-positioning ahead of the upcoming NU7 network upgrade, targeted for early November. The upgrade is expected to reduce block times from 75 seconds to 25 seconds and introduce changes to the network's fee mechanism, potentially improving transaction speed and long-term sustainability. Although, Zcash-specific catalysts can provide support for the cryptocurrency in the short-term, the macro fundamentals will still dictate the general trend.

The focus today will also be on the FOMC decision, with the Fed widely expected to leave interest rates unchanged. With no new projections or dot plot expected, the attention will be on Fed Chair Warsh's comments and the statement's language. A hawkish surprise could strengthen growth concerns and weigh on ZEC amid general risk aversion. A neutral hold that avoids signalling imminent tightening, on the other hand, could support a relief rally in the cryptocurrency.

 

ZCASH TECHNICAL ANALYSIS – DAILY TIMEFRAME

On the daily chart, we can see that Zcashis approaching a major resistance zone around the 1,380 level. If the price gets there, we can expect the sellers to step in, with a defined risk above the resistance, to position for a drop into the 1,031 support. The buyers, on the other hand, will want to see the price breaking higher to increase the bullish bets into the 1,692 level next.

ZCASH TECHNICAL ANALYSIS – 4 HOUR TIMEFRAME

On the 4 hour chart, we have an upward trendline defining the bullish momentum. The buyers will likely continue to lean on the trendline, with a defined risk below it, to keep pushing into new highs. The sellers, on the other hand, will look for a break lower to pile in for a drop into the 1,031 support next.

ZCASH TECHNICAL ANALYSIS – 1 HOUR TIMEFRAME

On the 1 hour chart, there’s not much we can add here as the sellers will likely wait for the price to come into the resistance or break below the trendline, while the buyers will look for a break above the resistance or a bounce around the trendline. The red lines define the average daily range for today.

UPCOMING CATALYSTS

Today we have the FOMC rate decision. Tomorrow, we get the US GDP report, the US PCE and the latest US Jobless Claims figures. On Friday, we conclude the week with the US Employment Cost Index.

This article was written by Giuseppe Dellamotta at investinglive.com.
